correctness.rationale: The quotient and dynamics are well defined for every integer m at least 2. Proximality to the common fixed point invokes the verified endpoint lemma; the full-support invariant measure is explicit; power transitivity is equivalent to solvability of the sheet congruence together with mixing of the base. The MEGF proof reduces each sheet return to the weakly mixing E-system (Y,g^m), forcing any equicontinuous generic factor to be constant per sheet. The ordinary-factor obstruction follows from the fixed point. No computation or finite experiment is used to infer an infinite statement. Scientific risk is limited to dependence on the cited published lemmas and the stated base properties, all of which were inspected in their primary sources.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a natural complete classification for a whole finite-cyclic family at the sharp alpha=0 endpoint: every cycle length is realized as the maximal equicontinuous generic obstruction, and every power is classified by gcd(r,m). This is structurally more informative than a routine m-copy variant because it identifies the universal generic factor and proves it cannot be promoted to an ordinary factor. The result directly explains the endpoint failure mechanism in the motivating 2026 theorem. The principal value risk is that specialists may regard the cyclic extension as folklore, but the maximality and exact power law supply substantive structure beyond the source's two-sheet example.
